title: $Γ$-convergence of free discontinuity problems for circle-valued maps in the linear regime
summary: We investigate the $Γ$-convergence of Ambrosio-Tortorelli type-functionals for circle valued functions, in the case of volume terms with linear growth. We show the emergence of a non-local $Γ$-limit, which is due to the topological structure of the target space, and discuss compactness of minimal liftings. Our results extend the analysis of a previous work on the quadratic case. Applications to the area functional are given.
